text: Marah (مرح), the Saudi shopping app for fresh meat, poultry, seafood and more, is owned and operated by Meatsteak Company (شركة ميتستيك), a registered Saudi company headquartered in Riyadh.
short: The Marah app is owned and operated by Meatsteak Company of Riyadh.

source.name: Marah app (marahapp.com): privacy policy page footer
source.quote: مرح مملوكة ومشغّلة من قِبل شركة ميتستيك، وهي شركة سعودية مسجلة ومقرها الرئيس في الرياض
source.note: Translation: 'Marah is owned and operated by Meatsteak Company, a registered Saudi company headquartered in Riyadh'; the same footer gives commercial registration 7052155863.
